name: codebuddy-local
description: Run locally using the installed CodeBuddy ACP command and its existing login; supply cwd when creating a session
before_start: Confirm that CodeBuddy is installed and its existing login is available before creating the session.
after_start: If authentication is required, complete the authentication flow and wait until the session is ready before sending work.
special_instructions: Ask the user for any missing model or cwd; do not guess credentials or enable yolo without approval.
